<script type="module">
import { db, getActiveSchoolId, getTodayISO, getSchoolClasses } from './js/firebase-config.js';
import { collection, addDoc, getDocs, doc, updateDoc, onSnapshot,
         query, where, orderBy, serverTimestamp } from 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.8.0/firebase-firestore.js';

let currentUser = null;
let todayUnsub = null;

// ══ Toast ══
window.showToast = function(msg, type='success') {
  document.querySelectorAll('.toast-msg').forEach(t=>t.remove());
  const colors = {success:'#059669',error:'#dc2626',info:'#1a78c2',warning:'#d97706'};
  const t = document.createElement('div');
  t.className = 'toast-msg';
  t.style.background = colors[type]||colors.success;
  t.textContent = msg;
  document.body.appendChild(t);
  setTimeout(()=>{t.style.opacity='0';t.style.transition='opacity .4s';setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),400);},2500);
};

// ══ Switch View ══
window.switchView = function(viewId) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-view').forEach(v=>v.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.bn-item').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById(viewId)?.classList.add('active');
  document.querySelector(`.bn-item[data-view="${viewId}"]`)?.classList.add('active');
  if(viewId==='view-today') loadTodayLive();
  if(viewId==='view-archive') setDefaultDates();
};

// ══ Init ══
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
  const saved = localStorage.getItem('hs_user');
  if(!saved) { window.location.replace('index.html'); return; }

  currentUser = JSON.parse(saved);
  if(!['nurse','admin','assistant_manager'].includes(currentUser.role)) {
    window.location.replace('index.html'); return;
  }

  document.getElementById('lbl-nurse-title').innerHTML = `<i class="bi bi-heart-pulse-fill"></i> أ. ${currentUser.name||'الممرض'}`;
  document.getElementById('lbl-nurse-school').textContent = currentUser.schoolName||'المنظومة الرقمية';
  document.getElementById('splash-school').textContent = currentUser.schoolName||'';

  // تحميل الفصول
  const classes = await getSchoolClasses(db, getActiveSchoolId());
  const sel = document.getElementById('nurse-class');
  sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- اختر الفصل --</option>' +
    classes.map(c=>`<option value="${c}">${c}</option>`).join('');

  // إحصائيات اليوم (live)
  loadStats();

  // تحميل بيانات الملف الشخصي
  loadProfile();

  document.getElementById('splash').classList.add('hide');
});

// ══ تحميل الطلاب ══
window.loadStudents = async function(classId) {
  const sel = document.getElementById('nurse-student');
  if(!classId) { sel.innerHTML='<option value="">-- اختر الفصل أولاً --</option>'; sel.disabled=true; return; }
  sel.innerHTML='<option value="">⏳ جاري التحميل...</option>';
  sel.disabled=true;
  try {
    const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db,'students'),
      where('schoolId','==',getActiveSchoolId()), where('classId','==',classId)));
    const names=[];
    snap.forEach(d=>{ if(d.data().name) names.push(d.data().name.trim()); });
    names.sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,'ar'));
    sel.innerHTML='<option value="">-- اختر الطالب --</option>'+names.map(n=>`<option value="${n}">${n}</option>`).join('');
    sel.disabled=false;
  } catch(e) { sel.innerHTML='<option value="">❌ خطأ</option>'; }
};

// ══ حفظ المراجعة ══
window.saveVisit = async function() {
  const classId   = document.getElementById('nurse-class').value;
  const student   = document.getElementById('nurse-student').value;
  const complaint = document.getElementById('nurse-complaint').value;
  const treatment = document.getElementById('nurse-treatment').value.trim();
  const result    = document.getElementById('nurse-result').value;
  const notes     = document.getElementById('nurse-notes').value.trim();

  if(!classId||!student) { showToast('اختر الفصل والطالب','error'); return; }

  const now = new Date();
  const timeStr = now.toLocaleTimeString('ar-KW',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});

  try {
    await addDoc(collection(db,'clinic'), {
      schoolId:    getActiveSchoolId(),
      classId,
      studentName: student,
      complaint,
      treatment:   treatment||'—',
      result,
      notes,
      date:        getTodayISO(),
      timeStr,
      nurseName:   currentUser.name||'',
      status:      result==='داخل العيادة'?'active':'done',
      createdAt:   serverTimestamp()
    });

    showToast(`✅ تم تسجيل مراجعة ${student}`);
    document.getElementById('nurse-class').value='';
    document.getElementById('nurse-student').innerHTML='<option value="">-- اختر الفصل أولاً --</option>';
    document.getElementById('nurse-student').disabled=true;
    document.getElementById('nurse-treatment').value='';
    document.getElementById('nurse-notes').value='';
  } catch(e) { showToast('❌ '+e.message,'error'); }
};

// ══ إحصائيات اليوم ══
function loadStats() {
  const schoolId = getActiveSchoolId();
  const today = getTodayISO();
  const q = query(collection(db,'clinic'), where('schoolId','==',schoolId), where('date','==',today));
  onSnapshot(q, snap=>{
    let inside=0, returned=0, sentHome=0;
    snap.forEach(d=>{
      const r=d.data().result||'';
      if(r==='داخل العيادة') inside++;
      else if(r==='رجع للفصل') returned++;
      else if(r==='أُرسل للبيت') sentHome++;
    });
    document.getElementById('stat-today').textContent=snap.size;
    document.getElementById('stat-inside').textContent=inside;
    document.getElementById('stat-returned').textContent=returned;
    document.getElementById('stat-sent-home').textContent=sentHome;
  });
}

// ══ مراجعات اليوم ══
function loadTodayLive() {
  if(todayUnsub) todayUnsub();
  const schoolId=getActiveSchoolId();
  const today=getTodayISO();
  const q=query(collection(db,'clinic'), where('schoolId','==',schoolId), where('date','==',today));
  todayUnsub=onSnapshot(q, snap=>{
    const list=document.getElementById('today-list');
    if(snap.empty){
      list.innerHTML='<div style="text-align:center;padding:30px;color:var(--mid);font-weight:700">لا توجد مراجعات اليوم بعد</div>';
      return;
    }
    const docs=[...snap.docs].sort((a,b)=>(b.data().createdAt?.seconds||0)-(a.data().createdAt?.seconds||0));
    list.innerHTML=docs.map(d=>{
      const v=d.data();
      const isDone=v.status==='done';
      return `
      <div class="record-card" style="${isDone?'opacity:.6':''}">
        <div class="record-info">
          <h3>👤 ${v.studentName} — ${v.classId}</h3>
          <span class="complaint-badge">${v.complaint}</span>
          <p style="margin-top:6px">💊 ${v.treatment} | <b>${v.result}</b></p>
          ${v.notes?`<p style="color:var(--mid);font-size:11px;margin-top:3px">📝 ${v.notes}</p>`:''}
        </div>
        <div style="text-align:left;flex-shrink:0;">
          <div class="record-time">${v.timeStr||''}</div>
          ${v.status==='active'?`
          <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-top:8px">
            <button class="btn-exit-student" onclick="updateResult('${d.id}','رجع للفصل')" style="background:var(--green)">✅ رجع الفصل</button>
            <button class="btn-exit-student" onclick="updateResult('${d.id}','أُرسل للبيت')">🏠 أُرسل للبيت</button>
          </div>`:'<div style="color:var(--green);font-weight:700;font-size:12px;margin-top:8px">✔ مكتمل</div>'}
        </div>
      </div>`;
    }).join('');
  });
}

// ══ تحديث نتيجة ══
window.updateResult = async function(docId, newResult) {
  try {
    await updateDoc(doc(db,'clinic',docId), { result:newResult, status:'done' });
    showToast(`✅ تم تحديث الحالة: ${newResult}`);
  } catch(e){ showToast('❌ '+e.message,'error'); }
};

// ══ الأرشيف ══
function setDefaultDates() {
  const today=getTodayISO();
  const weekAgo=new Date(); weekAgo.setDate(weekAgo.getDate()-7);
  document.getElementById('archive-date-from').value=weekAgo.toISOString().slice(0,10);
  document.getElementById('archive-date-to').value=today;
}

window.loadArchive = async function() {
  const from=document.getElementById('archive-date-from').value;
  const to=document.getElementById('archive-date-to').value;
  if(!from||!to){ showToast('اختر نطاق التاريخ','info'); return; }
  const tbody=document.getElementById('archive-tbody');
  tbody.innerHTML='<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center;padding:20px">⏳ جاري البحث...</td></tr>';
  try {
    const snap=await getDocs(query(collection(db,'clinic'),
      where('schoolId','==',getActiveSchoolId()),
      where('date','>=',from), where('date','<=',to)));
    if(snap.empty){ tbody.innerHTML='<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center;padding:20px;color:var(--mid)">لا توجد سجلات</td></tr>'; return; }
    const docs=[...snap.docs].sort((a,b)=>b.data().date.localeCompare(a.data().date));
    tbody.innerHTML=docs.map(d=>{
      const v=d.data();
      return `<tr>
        <td style="padding:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)">${v.date||'—'} ${v.timeStr?'('+v.timeStr+')':''}</td>
        <td style="padding:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:700">${v.studentName||'—'}</td>
        <td style="padding:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)">${v.classId||'—'}</td>
        <td style="padding:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)">${v.complaint||'—'}</td>
        <td style="padding:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:700;color:var(--green)">${v.result||'—'}</td>
      </tr>`;
    }).join('');
  } catch(e){ tbody.innerHTML=`<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center;color:red;padding:20px">❌ ${e.message}</td></tr>`; }
};

async function loadProfile() {
  try {
    const snap=await getDocs(query(collection(db,'users'),
      where('schoolId','==',getActiveSchoolId()), where('userId','==',currentUser.userId)));
    if(snap.empty) return;
    const d=snap.docs[0].data();
    document.getElementById('nurse-name').value=d.name||'';
    document.getElementById('nurse-phone').value=d.phone||'';
    document.getElementById('nurse-email').value=d.email||'';
  } catch(e){}
}

window.saveProfile = async function() {
  const name=document.getElementById('nurse-name').value.trim();
  const phone=document.getElementById('nurse-phone').value.trim();
  const email=document.getElementById('nurse-email').value.trim();
  const pass=document.getElementById('nurse-pass').value.trim();
  if(!name){ showToast('الاسم مطلوب','error'); return; }
  try {
    const snap=await getDocs(query(collection(db,'users'),
      where('schoolId','==',getActiveSchoolId()), where('userId','==',currentUser.userId)));
    if(snap.empty){ showToast('⚠️ تعذر إيجاد حسابك','error'); return; }
    await updateDoc(snap.docs[0].ref,{name,phone,email});
    if(pass){
      try {
        const {getFunctions,httpsCallable}=await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.8.0/firebase-functions.js');
        const fns=getFunctions(undefined, 'me-central1');
        await httpsCallable(fns,'resetUserPassword')({userDocId:snap.docs[0].id,newPassword:pass});
      } catch(pe){ showToast('⚠️ تم الحفظ لكن تعذر تغيير كلمة المرور','warning'); }
    }
    currentUser.name=name;
    localStorage.setItem('hs_user',JSON.stringify(currentUser));
    document.getElementById('lbl-nurse-title').innerHTML=`<i class="bi bi-heart-pulse-fill"></i> أ. ${name}`;
    document.getElementById('nurse-pass').value='';
    showToast('✅ تم حفظ بياناتك بنجاح');
  } catch(e){ showToast('❌ '+e.message,'error'); }
};


// ══ واتساب ولي الأمر من العيادة ══
window.sendClinicWhatsApp = async function(studentName, classId, complaint, result) {
    try {
        const { collection, query, where, getDocs } =
            await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.8.0/firebase-firestore.js');
        const { db, getActiveSchoolId } = await import('./js/firebase-config.js');

        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db,'students'),
            where('schoolId','==',getActiveSchoolId()),
            where('name','==',studentName),
            where('classId','==',classId)));

        if(snap.empty){ showToast('⚠️ لم يُعثر على بيانات الطالب','warning'); return; }
        const phone = (snap.docs[0].data().parentPhone||'').replace(/\D/g,'');
        if(!phone){ showToast('⚠️ لا يوجد رقم هاتف لولي الأمر','warning'); return; }

        const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString('ar-KW',{year:'numeric',month:'long',day:'numeric'});
        const schoolName = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('hs_user')||'{}').schoolName || 'المدرسة';
        const msg = encodeURIComponent(
            `السلام عليكم ولي أمر الطالب ${studentName}،\n` +
            `نُعلمكم بأن ابنكم راجع عيادة ${schoolName} اليوم ${today}.\n` +
            `الشكوى: ${complaint||'—'}\n` +
            `النتيجة: ${result||'—'}\n` +
            `للاستفسار تواصلوا مع إدارة المدرسة.`
        );
        window.open(`https://wa.me/965${phone}?text=${msg}`, '_blank');
    } catch(e){ showToast('❌ '+e.message,'error'); }
};

window.doLogout=function(){
  localStorage.removeItem('hs_user');
  window.location.replace('index.html');
};

<script type="module">
import { auth } from './js/firebase-config.js';
import { getFunctions, httpsCallable } from 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.8.0/firebase-functions.js';
import { signInWithCustomToken } from 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.8.0/firebase-auth.js';
import { getFirestore, doc, getDoc } from 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.8.0/firebase-firestore.js';

const fns = getFunctions(auth.app, 'me-central1');
const loginParentFn = httpsCallable(fns, 'loginParent');
const db2 = getFirestore(auth.app);

const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const schoolFromUrl = urlParams.get('school')?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
if (schoolFromUrl) {
    document.getElementById('inp-school').value = schoolFromUrl;
    document.getElementById('inp-school').readOnly = true;
    loadSchoolName(schoolFromUrl);
}

// تحقق لو مسجل دخول بالفعل
const saved = localStorage.getItem('hs_parent');
if (saved) {
    try { JSON.parse(saved); window.location.replace('parent.html'); } catch(e) {}
}

async function loadSchoolName(sid) {
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db2, 'schools', sid));
        if (snap.exists()) document.getElementById('school-name-header').textContent = snap.data().name || sid;
    } catch(e) {}
}

function showErr(msg) {
    const el = document.getElementById('err-login');
    el.textContent = msg;
    el.classList.add('show');
}

window.doLogin = async function() {
    document.getElementById('err-login').classList.remove('show');
    const schoolId = document.getElementById('inp-school').value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const civilId = document.getElementById('inp-civil').value.trim();
    const pass = document.getElementById('inp-pass').value;

    if (!schoolId || !civilId || !pass) return showErr('⚠️ أكمل جميع الحقول');

    const btn = document.getElementById('btn-login');
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-hourglass-split"></i> جاري التحقق...';

    try {
        const result = await loginParentFn({ schoolId, civilId, password: pass });
        const data = result.data;

        await signInWithCustomToken(auth, data.token);

        localStorage.setItem('hs_parent', JSON.stringify({
            userId: data.userId,
            civilId,
            role: 'parent',
            schoolId: data.schoolId,
            schoolName: data.schoolName || '',
            studentName: data.studentName || '',
            studentId: data.studentId || '',
            classId: data.classId || ''
        }));

        window.location.replace('parent.html');

    } catch(e) {
        const msgs = {
            'functions/unauthenticated': '❌ كلمة المرور غير صحيحة',
            'functions/not-found': '❌ الحساب غير موجود — سجّل أولاً',
            'functions/resource-exhausted': '⏳ ' + (e.message || 'تجاوزت المحاولات، انتظر قليلاً'),
            'functions/invalid-argument': '⚠️ أدخل البيانات بشكل صحيح'
        };
        showErr(msgs[e.code] || ('❌ ' + (e.message || 'حدث خطأ، حاول مرة أخرى')));
    } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-box-arrow-in-left"></i> تسجيل الدخول';
    }
};

window.goRegister = function() {
    const sid = document.getElementById('inp-school').value.trim();
    window.location.href = 'register-parent.html' + (sid ? '?school='+sid : '');
};

document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if(e.key==='Enter') doLogin(); });
</script>

<script type="module">
import { auth } from './js/firebase-config.js';
import { getFirestore, collection, getDocs, query, where, orderBy, limit }
  from 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.8.0/firebase-firestore.js';

// التحقق من الجلسة
const saved = localStorage.getItem('hs_parent');
if (!saved) { window.location.replace('parent-login.html'); }
let me = {};
try {
    me = JSON.parse(saved);
    if (!me.schoolId) throw new Error('no schoolId');
} catch(e) {
    localStorage.removeItem('hs_parent');
    window.location.replace('parent-login.html');
}

document.getElementById('topbar-name').textContent = '👨‍👩‍👦 ' + (me.studentName || 'ولي الأمر');
document.getElementById('topbar-school').textContent = me.schoolName || '';

const db = getFirestore(auth.app);
const schoolId = me.schoolId;
const studentId = me.studentId || '';
const studentName = me.studentName || '';

window.switchPage = function(pageId, btn) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
    document.getElementById(pageId)?.classList.add('active');
    if(btn) btn.classList.add('active');
};

window.doLogout = function() {
    if (!confirm('هل تريد تسجيل الخروج؟')) return;
    localStorage.removeItem('hs_parent');
    window.location.replace('parent-login.html');
};

// بيانات الطالب
document.getElementById('student-info').innerHTML = `
    <div class="info-item"><div class="lbl">اسم الطالب</div><div class="val">${studentName || '—'}</div></div>
    <div class="info-item"><div class="lbl">الفصل</div><div class="val">${me.classId || '—'}</div></div>
    <div class="info-item"><div class="lbl">المدرسة</div><div class="val">${me.schoolName || '—'}</div></div>
    <div class="info-item"><div class="lbl">رقم الطالب</div><div class="val">${studentId || '—'}</div></div>
`;

// تحميل البيانات
(async function() {
    try {
        // سجل الغياب
        const attQ = query(
            collection(db, 'attendance'),
            where('schoolId','==',schoolId),
            where('studentId','==',studentId),
            orderBy('date','desc'),
            limit(20)
        );
        const attSnap = await getDocs(attQ);
        const absList = document.getElementById('absence-list');

        if (attSnap.empty) {
            absList.innerHTML = '<div class="empty" style="color:var(--green)">✅ لا يوجد غياب مسجّل — ممتاز!</div>';
        } else {
            const labels = {absent:'غائب',late:'متأخر',excused:'مستأذن'};
            const cls = {absent:'badge-absent',late:'badge-late',excused:'badge-excused'};
            let absent=0, late=0;
            absList.innerHTML = attSnap.docs.map(d => {
                const r = d.data();
                if(r.status==='absent') absent++;
                if(r.status==='late') late++;
                return `<div class="absent-day">
                    <span class="date">${r.date||''}</span>
                    <span class="badge ${cls[r.status]||'badge-absent'}">${labels[r.status]||r.status}</span>
                    <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--mid)">${r.period||''}</span>
                </div>`;
            }).join('');
            document.getElementById('stat-absent').textContent = absent;
            document.getElementById('stat-late').textContent = late;
        }

        // ملاحظات المعلمين
        const notesQ = query(
            collection(db,'student_notes'),
            where('schoolId','==',schoolId),
            where('studentId','==',studentId),
            orderBy('createdAt','desc'),
            limit(30)
        );
        const notesSnap = await getDocs(notesQ);
        const notesDiv = document.getElementById('teacher-notes');
        document.getElementById('stat-notes').textContent = notesSnap.size;

        if (notesSnap.empty) {
            notesDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">لا توجد ملاحظات</div>';
        } else {
            notesDiv.innerHTML = notesSnap.docs.map(d => {
                const n = d.data();
                const date = n.createdAt?.toDate?.()?.toLocaleDateString('ar-KW') || n.date || '';
                return `<div class="note-item">
                    <div>
                        <span class="note-teacher">${n.teacherName||''}</span>
                        <span class="note-date">${date}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="note-text">${n.note||''}</div>
                </div>`;
            }).join('');
        }

        // إظهار الإحصائيات
        document.getElementById('stats-card').style.display = 'block';

        // الإعلانات
        const annQ = query(
            collection(db,'school_announcements'),
            where('schoolId','==',schoolId),
            where('active','==',true),
            orderBy('createdAt','desc'),
            limit(10)
        );
        const annSnap = await getDocs(annQ);

        if (!annSnap.empty) {
            document.getElementById('home-announcements').innerHTML =
                `<div class="card" style="background:#fef3c7;border-color:#fbbf24">
                    <h2 style="color:#92400e"><i class="bi bi-megaphone-fill"></i> إعلانات المدرسة</h2>
                    ${annSnap.docs.slice(0,3).map(d=>`<div class="ann-item">${d.data().text||''}</div>`).join('')}
                </div>`;

            document.getElementById('ann-list').innerHTML = annSnap.docs.map(d => {
                const a = d.data();
                const date = a.createdAt?.toDate?.()?.toLocaleDateString('ar-KW',{month:'long',day:'numeric'}) || '';
                return `<div class="ann-item" style="padding:12px 0">
                    <div>${a.text||''}</div>
                    ${date ? `<div style="font-size:11px;color:#b45309;margin-top:4px"><i class="bi bi-calendar3"></i> ${date}</div>` : ''}
                </div>`;
            }).join('');
        } else {
            document.getElementById('ann-list').innerHTML = '<div class="empty">لا توجد إعلانات</div>';
        }

    } catch(e) {
        console.error('Parent load:', e);
        document.getElementById('absence-list').innerHTML = `<div class="empty" style="color:var(--red)">❌ خطأ في التحميل: ${e.message}</div>`;
    }
})();

if('serviceWorker' in navigator) navigator.serviceWorker.register('./sw.js').catch(()=>{});
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script type="module">
import { auth } from './js/firebase-config.js';
import { getFunctions, httpsCallable } from 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.8.0/firebase-functions.js';
import { getFirestore, doc, getDoc } from 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.8.0/firebase-firestore.js';

const fns = getFunctions(auth.app, 'me-central1');
const sendParentOTPFn = httpsCallable(fns, 'sendParentOTP');
const verifyOTPFn = httpsCallable(fns, 'verifyOTPAndRegister');
const db2 = getFirestore(auth.app);

const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const schoolFromUrl = urlParams.get('school')?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
if (schoolFromUrl) {
    document.getElementById('inp-school').value = schoolFromUrl;
    document.getElementById('inp-school').readOnly = true;
    loadSchoolName(schoolFromUrl);
}

async function loadSchoolName(sid) {
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db2, 'schools', sid));
        if (snap.exists()) document.getElementById('school-name-header').textContent = snap.data().name || sid;
    } catch(e) {}
}

function showErr(id, msg) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    el.textContent = msg;
    el.classList.add('show');
}
function hideErr(id) { document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('show'); }

function setStep(n) {
    [1,2,3].forEach(i => {
        document.getElementById('page'+i)?.classList.remove('active');
        const s = document.getElementById('step'+i);
        s.classList.remove('active','done');
        if (i < n) s.classList.add('done');
        if (i === n) s.classList.add('active');
    });
    document.getElementById('page-success').classList.remove('active');
    if (n <= 3) document.getElementById('page'+n).classList.add('active');
}

function setStepSuccess() {
    [1,2,3].forEach(i => {
        document.getElementById('step'+i).classList.remove('active');
        document.getElementById('step'+i).classList.add('done');
    });
    document.getElementById('page1').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('page2').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('page3').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('page-success').classList.add('active');
}

window.goBack = function(n) { setStep(n); };

window.sendOTP = async function() {
    hideErr('err1');
    const schoolId = document.getElementById('inp-school').value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const studentCivilId = document.getElementById('inp-student-civil').value.trim();
    const phone = document.getElementById('inp-phone').value.trim();

    if (!schoolId || !studentCivilId || !phone) return showErr('err1','⚠️ أكمل جميع الحقول');
    if (phone.length < 7) return showErr('err1','⚠️ رقم الهاتف غير صحيح');

    const btn = document.getElementById('btn-send-otp');
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-hourglass-split"></i> جاري الإرسال...';

    try {
        await sendParentOTPFn({ schoolId, phone: '965'+phone, studentCivilId });
        window._regData = { schoolId, phone: '965'+phone, studentCivilId };
        setStep(2);
    } catch(e) {
        showErr('err1', '❌ ' + (e.message || 'تعذر الإرسال، تأكد من البيانات'));
    } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-send-fill"></i> إرسال رمز التحقق';
    }
};

window.resendOTP = async function() {
    if (!window._regData) return;
    document.getElementById('btn-resend').disabled = true;
    try {
        await sendParentOTPFn(window._regData);
        document.getElementById('err2').classList.remove('show');
        document.getElementById('inp-otp').value = '';
    } catch(e) {
        showErr('err2', '❌ ' + (e.message || 'تعذر إعادة الإرسال'));
    } finally {
        document.getElementById('btn-resend').disabled = false;
    }
};

window.verifyStep = function() {
    hideErr('err2');
    const otp = document.getElementById('inp-otp').value.trim();
    if (otp.length !== 6) return showErr('err2','⚠️ أدخل رمز التحقق المكون من 6 أرقام');
    window._otp = otp;
    setStep(3);
};

window.doRegister = async function() {
    hideErr('err3');
    const civilId = document.getElementById('inp-civil').value.trim();
    const pass = document.getElementById('inp-pass').value;
    const pass2 = document.getElementById('inp-pass2').value;

    if (!civilId) return showErr('err3','⚠️ أدخل رقمك المدني');
    if (pass.length < 8) return showErr('err3','⚠️ كلمة المرور يجب أن تكون 8 أحرف على الأقل');
    if (pass !== pass2) return showErr('err3','⚠️ كلمتا المرور غير متطابقتين');

    const btn = document.getElementById('btn-register');
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-hourglass-split"></i> جاري الإنشاء...';

    try {
        await verifyOTPFn({
            schoolId: window._regData.schoolId,
            civilId,
            phone: window._regData.phone,
            password: pass,
            otp: window._otp
        });
        setStepSuccess();
    } catch(e) {
        const msgs = {
            'functions/already-exists': '❌ هذا الحساب موجود مسبقاً، يمكنك تسجيل الدخول مباشرة',
            'functions/unauthenticated': '❌ رمز التحقق غير صحيح أو منتهي الصلاحية',
            'functions/deadline-exceeded': '❌ انتهت صلاحية رمز التحقق — أعد الإرسال',
            'functions/not-found': '❌ لم يتم طلب رمز تحقق'
        };
        showErr('err3', msgs[e.code] || ('❌ ' + (e.message || 'حدث خطأ، حاول مرة أخرى')));
    } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-person-check-fill"></i> إنشاء الحساب';
    }
};

window.goToLogin = function() {
    const sid = window._regData?.schoolId || '';
    window.location.href = 'parent-login.html' + (sid ? '?school='+sid : '');
};
</script>

</body>
</html>

<script type="module">
import { db, getActiveSchoolId, getTodayISO, getSchoolClasses } from './js/firebase-config.js';
import { collection, addDoc, doc, updateDoc, onSnapshot, getDocs, query, where, serverTimestamp } from 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.8.0/firebase-firestore.js';

let currentWorkerId = "";
let currentWorkerName = "الأخصائي الاجتماعي";

// getActiveSchoolId مستوردة من firebase-config.js

function getUnifiedDateString() {
    const d = new Date();
    const year = d.getFullYear();
    const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${year}/${month}/${day}`;
}

function getUnifiedTimeString() {
    const d = new Date(); let hours = d.getHours(); let minutes = d.getMinutes();
    let ampm = hours >= 12 ? 'مساءً' : 'صباحاً';
    hours = hours % 12; hours = hours ? hours : 12;
    minutes = minutes < 10 ? '0' + minutes : minutes;
    return `${hours}:${minutes} ${ampm}`;
}

window.switchTabView = function(viewId) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-view').forEach(v => v.classList.remove('active-view'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.bn-item').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));

    const targetView = document.getElementById(viewId);
    if(targetView) targetView.classList.add('active-view');

    if(viewId === 'view-gatepass') document.getElementById('tab-btn-gatepass').classList.add('active');
    if(viewId === 'view-behavior') document.getElementById('tab-btn-behavior').classList.add('active');
    if(viewId === 'view-profile') document.getElementById('tab-btn-profile').classList.add('active');
    if(viewId === 'view-messages') document.getElementById('tab-btn-messages').classList.add('active');
    if(viewId === 'view-settings') document.getElementById('tab-btn-settings').classList.add('active');

    const bnBtn = document.querySelector(`.bn-item[data-bn-view="${viewId}"]`);
    if(bnBtn) bnBtn.classList.add('active');
};

// ---
window.populateStudentsDropdownUnified = async function(classSelectId, studentSelectId) {
    const classId = document.getElementById(classSelectId).value;
    const nameSelect = document.getElementById(studentSelectId);
    if (!nameSelect) return;
    
    nameSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">⏳ جاري جرد الأسماء وترتيبها أبجدياً...</option>';
    const schoolId = getActiveSchoolId();
    
    try {
        const uniqueNames = new Set();
        
        // 🏢 استعلام آمن ومقيد بمعرف المدرسة لمنع خلط الفصول
        const qStudents = query(
            collection(db, 'students'), 
            where('schoolId', '==', schoolId), 
            where('classId', '==', classId)
        );
        const snapStud = await getDocs(qStudents);
        snapStud.forEach(doc => {
            if (doc.data().name) uniqueNames.add(doc.data().name.trim());
        });
        
        if (uniqueNames.size === 0) {
            nameSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">❌ لا يوجد طلاب مسجلين في هذا الفصل حالياً</option>';
            return;
        }
        
        const sortedNames = Array.from(uniqueNames).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, 'ar'));
        
        let optionsHtml = '<option value="">👇 اختر اسم الطالب الحين</option>';
        sortedNames.forEach(name => {
            optionsHtml += `<option value="${name}">${name}</option>`;
        });
        nameSelect.innerHTML = optionsHtml;
    } catch (err) {
        nameSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">❌ خطأ في سحب كشف الأسماء</option>';
    }
};

// 🎫 بث استئذان مع توثيق كود الترخيص السحابي للمدرسة الحالية
window.broadcastGatepassLive = async function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const classId = document.getElementById('pass-class').value;
    const studentName = document.getElementById('pass-student-name').value;
    const relative = document.getElementById('pass-relative').value.trim();
    const relation = document.getElementById('pass-relation').value;
    const civil = document.getElementById('pass-civil').value.trim();
    const phone = document.getElementById('pass-phone').value.trim();
    const reason = document.getElementById('pass-reason').value.trim();
    const schoolId = getActiveSchoolId();

    if(!studentName) { showToast("⚠️ يرجى اختيار اسم الطالب أولاً من القائمة!"); return; }
    if (civil.length !== 12) { showToast("⚠️ الرقم المدني للمستلم يجب أن يتكون من 12 رقم بالملي!"); return; }

    try {
        await addDoc(collection(db, 'gatepass'), {
            schoolId: schoolId, // 🔑 البصمة الأمنية للـ SaaS
            classId, studentName, relative, relation, relativeCivilId: civil, relativePhone: phone, reason,
            status: 'approved', dateStr: getUnifiedDateString(), timeStr: getUnifiedTimeString(), officerName: currentWorkerName
        });
        showToast(`✓ تم بث استئذان الطالب [ ${studentName} ] بنجاح.`);
        document.getElementById('social-gatepass-form').reset();
        window.populateStudentsDropdownUnified('pass-class', 'pass-student-name');
    } catch (err) { showToast("❌ خطأ: " + err.message, "error"); }
};

// 🛡️ رصد وإثبات المخالفات والتميز السلوكي
window.saveBehaviorLogLive = async function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const classId = document.getElementById('beh-class').value;
    const studentName = document.getElementById('beh-student-name').value;
    const type = document.getElementById('beh-type').value;
    const details = document.getElementById('beh-details').value.trim();
    const action = document.getElementById('beh-action').value.trim();
    const followup = document.getElementById('beh-followup').value;
    const schoolId = getActiveSchoolId();

    if(!studentName) { showToast("⚠️ يرجى اختيار اسم الطالب أولاً لرصد حالته!"); return; }

    try {
        // 🔗 موحّد مع نفس كولكشن "behavior" المستخدم بصفحة المدير والمعلم
        await addDoc(collection(db, 'behavior'), {
            schoolId: schoolId, // 🔑 فصل البيانات للسيرفر
            classId, studentName, name: studentName,
            type, notes: details, action,
            referredBy: currentWorkerName, followUpStatus: followup,
            dateStr: getUnifiedDateString(), date: getUnifiedDateString(), timeStr: getUnifiedTimeString(),
            officerName: currentWorkerName, createdAt: serverTimestamp()
        });
        showToast(`✓ تم توثيق ورصد الحالة السلوكية بنجاح للطالب [ ${studentName} ].`);
        document.getElementById('social-behavior-form').reset();
        window.populateStudentsDropdownUnified('beh-class', 'beh-student-name');
    } catch(err) { showToast("❌ خطأ بالحفظ: " + err.message, "error"); }
};

// 👤 فحص رادار الـ 360 درجة لملف الطالب الموحد محلياً داخل نطاق المنشأة
window.searchStudentFullProfileLive = async function() {
    const sClass = document.getElementById('txt-profile-search-class').value;
    const sName = document.getElementById('txt-profile-search-name').value;
    if(!sName) { showToast("⚠️ يرجى اختيار اسم الطالب من القائمة أولاً لفحص سجلاته."); return; }

    const boxResults = document.getElementById('box-profile-results');
    const tableBeh = document.getElementById('table-profile-behavior');
    const tableGate = document.getElementById('table-profile-gatepass');
    const tableAtt = document.getElementById('table-profile-attendance');
    const schoolId = getActiveSchoolId();
    
    tableAtt.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="4" style="text-align:center;">🔍 جاري فحص ملف الانتظام الدراسي والغيابات...</td></tr>';
    tableBeh.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="4" style="text-align:center;">🔍 جاري فحص ملف المتابعة السلوكية...</td></tr>';
    tableGate.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center;">🔍 جاري فحص أرشيف الأذونات وبوابة الأمن...</td></tr>';
    boxResults.style.display = 'block';

    document.getElementById('lbl-profile-student-name').innerText = `👤 ملف الطالب الشامل: ${sName}`;
    document.getElementById('lbl-profile-student-class').innerText = `الفصل الدراسي المعتمد بالفحص: صف ( ${sClass} )`;

    // أ) جلب الغياب المسجل من موديول المعلمين للمدرسة الحالية
    try {
        const qAtt = query(
            collection(db, 'attendance'), 
            where('schoolId', '==', schoolId),
            where('studentName', '==', sName.trim())
        );
        const snapAtt = await getDocs(qAtt);
        let hAtt = '';
        snapAtt.forEach(doc => {
            const d = doc.data();
            const badgeColor = d.status === 'absent' ? 'background:var(--danger-color);' : 'background:var(--success-color);';
            const statusText = d.status === 'absent' ? 'غياب' : 'حضور';
            hAtt += `<tr>
                <td>🕒 ${d.date || '-'}</td>
                <td><span style="color:#fff; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px; ${badgeColor}">${statusText}</span></td>
                <td style="font-weight:bold;">الحصة: ${d.period || 'غير محددة'}</td>
                <td>${d.teacherName || 'سستم الحضور الآلي'}</td>
            </tr>`;
        });
        tableAtt.innerHTML = hAtt || `<tr><td colspan="4" style="text-align:center; color:#999;">✨ سجل الطالب ممتاز تماماً، لا توجد أي حالات غياب مرصودة.</td></tr>`;
    } catch(e) { tableAtt.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="4">خطأ في الحضور: ${e.message}</td></tr>`; }

    // ب) جلب السجل السلوكي للمدرسة الحالية
    try {
        const qBeh = query(
            collection(db, 'behavior'),
            where('schoolId', '==', schoolId),
            where('studentName', '==', sName.trim())
        );
        const snapBeh = await getDocs(qBeh);
        let hBeh = '';
        snapBeh.forEach(doc => {
            const d = doc.data();
            const badgeColor = d.type === 'سلبي' ? 'background:var(--danger-color);' : (d.type === 'إيجابي' ? 'background:var(--success-color);' : 'background:#94a3b8;');
            hBeh += `<tr>
                <td>🕒 ${d.dateStr || d.date || '-'}</td>
                <td><span style="color:#fff; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px; ${badgeColor}">${d.type || '—'}</span></td>
                <td>${d.notes || d.details || '-'}</td>
                <td style="color:var(--hover-color);">${d.action || '-'}</td>
            </tr>`;
        });
        tableBeh.innerHTML = hBeh || `<tr><td colspan="4" style="text-align:center; color:#999;">✅ السجل السلوكي للطالب نظيف تماماً في هذه المنشأة.</td></tr>`;
    } catch(e) { tableBeh.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="4">خطأ في السلوك: ${e.message}</td></tr>`; }

    // ج) جلب سجل الاستئذان المعتمد وبوابة الأمن للمدرسة الحالية
    try {
        const qGate = query(
            collection(db, 'gatepass'),
            where('schoolId', '==', schoolId),
            where('studentName', '==', sName.trim())
        );
        const snapGate = await getDocs(qGate);
        let hGate = '';
        snapGate.forEach(doc => {
            const d = doc.data();
            let statusBadge = d.status === 'exited' ? 'background:var(--success-color); color:#fff;' : 'background:var(--warning-color); color:#fff;';
            let statusText = d.status === 'exited' ? 'غادر المدرسة رسميًا ✅' : 'مأذون له / معلق عند الباب ⏳';
            hGate += `<tr>
                <td>🕒 ${d.dateStr || '-'}</td> <td>${d.relative || '-'}</td> <td>${d.relation || '-'}</td> <td>${d.reason || '-'}</td>
                <td><span style="padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px; ${statusBadge}">${statusText}</span></td>
            </tr>`;
        });
        tableGate.innerHTML = hGate || `<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center; color:#999;">💡 لم يتم رصد أي استئذانات سابقة للطالب خلال العام الدراسي الحالي.</td></tr>`;
    } catch(e) { tableGate.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="5">خطأ في الأذونات: ${e.message}</td></tr>`; }
};

// 📋 بث نشر وتوزيع التعاميم داخل المدرسة الحالية
window.saveNewCircularLive = async function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const title = document.getElementById('msg-title').value.trim();
    const target = document.getElementById('msg-target').value;
    const content = document.getElementById('msg-content').value.trim();
    const schoolId = getActiveSchoolId();

    try {
        await addDoc(collection(db, 'circulars'), {

        });
        showToast("✓ تم نشر وتعميم التوجيه بنجاح، وظهر في لوحات التحكم المستهدفة الحين.");

    } catch(err) { showToast("❌ خطأ بالبث: " + err.message, "error"); }
};

// ⚙️ تحديث البروفايل الشخصي للأخصائي
window.updateSocialProfileLive = async function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const newName = document.getElementById('social-profile-name').value.trim();
    const newEmail = document.getElementById('social-profile-email').value.trim();
    const newPhone = document.getElementById('social-profile-phone').value.trim();
    const newPass = document.getElementById('social-profile-pass').value.trim();

    try {
        const schoolId = getActiveSchoolId();
        const q = query(collection(db, 'users'), where('schoolId','==',schoolId), where('userId','==',currentWorkerId));
        const snap = await getDocs(q);
        if (snap.empty) { showToast('⚠️ تعذر إيجاد حسابك بقاعدة البيانات.'); return; }

        const userDocRef = snap.docs[0].ref;
        let updatedData = { name: newName, email: newEmail, phone: newPhone };
        // كلمة المرور تُغيَّر عبر Cloud Function
        await updateDoc(userDocRef, updatedData);

        // ✅ تغيير كلمة المرور عبر Cloud Function (مشفّر آمن)
        if (newPass) {
            try {
                const { getFunctions, httpsCallable } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.8.0/firebase-functions.js');
                const fns = getFunctions(auth.app, 'me-central1');
                const resetFn = httpsCallable(fns, 'resetUserPassword');
                await resetFn({ userDocId: snap.docs[0].id, newPassword: newPass });
            } catch(passErr) {
                showToast('⚠️ تم حفظ البيانات لكن تعذر تغيير كلمة المرور: ' + passErr.message, 'warning');
            }
        }
        
        const localData = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('hs_user') || '{}');
        localData.name = newName;
        localStorage.setItem('hs_user', JSON.stringify(localData));

        showToast("✓ تم تحديث ملفك الشخصي وكلمة المرور بنجاح تام بقاعدة البيانات.");
        window.location.replace('social.html');
    } catch(err) { showToast("❌ خطأ في الحفظ: " + err.message, "error"); }
};

// ⚡ الاستماع المركزي اللحظي المقيد بـ schoolId لمنع تداخل المدارس
function startSocialCentralListeners() {
    const schoolId = getActiveSchoolId();

    // 1. مراقبة وجرد أرشيف البوابة الخارجة
    const qGate = query(collection(db, 'gatepass'), where('schoolId', '==', schoolId));
    onSnapshot(qGate, (snapshot) => {
        const searchDate = document.getElementById('txt-search-date').value.trim();
        const tbody = document.getElementById('social-archive-tbody');
        if(!tbody) return;
        let html = ''; let todayCount = 0;
        const todayStr = getUnifiedDateString();
        
        snapshot.forEach(doc => {
            const d = doc.data();
            if (d.dateStr === todayStr || d.date === todayStr) todayCount++;
            if (d.dateStr === searchDate) {
                html += `<tr>
                    <td>🕒 ${d.dateStr || '-'}</td> <td><b>👤 ${d.studentName || '-'}</b></td>
                    <td><span style="background:var(--mid); color:#fff; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px;">${d.classId || '-'}</span></td>
                    <td>${d.relative || '-'}</td> <td>${d.relation || '-'}</td> <td><code>${d.relativeCivilId || '-'}</code></td>
                    <td><a href="tel:${d.relativePhone}">${d.relativePhone || '-'}</a></td> <td>${d.reason || '-'}</td>
                </tr>`;
            }
        });
        document.getElementById('lbl-count-today').innerText = todayCount;
        tbody.innerHTML = html || '<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align:center; color:#999;">💡 لا توجد تصاريح استئذان مسجلة بالتاريخ المحدد.</td></tr>';
    });

    // 2. مراقبة وإحصاء السجل السلوكي المركزي (موحّد مع المدير والمعلم بكولكشن "behavior")
    const qBeh = query(collection(db, 'behavior'), where('schoolId', '==', schoolId));
    onSnapshot(qBeh, (snapshot) => {
        const tbody = document.getElementById('social-behavior-tbody');
        let html = ''; let posCount = 0; let negCount = 0;
        
        snapshot.forEach(doc => {
            const d = doc.data();
            if(d.type === 'إيجابي') posCount++; else if(d.type === 'سلبي') negCount++;
            const typeBadge = d.type === 'سلبي' ? 'var(--danger-color)' : (d.type === 'إيجابي' ? 'var(--success-color)' : '#94a3b8');

            html += `<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0;">
                <td>🕒 ${d.dateStr || d.date || '-'}</td> <td><b>👤 ${d.studentName || d.name || '-'}</b></td>
                <td><span style="background:var(--off); color:#fff; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px;">${d.classId || '-'}</span></td>
                <td><span style="background:${typeBadge}; color:#fff; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px;">${d.type || '—'}</span></td>
                <td>${d.notes || d.details || '-'}</td> <td style="color:var(--hover-color); font-weight:bold;">${d.action || '-'}</td> <td>أ. ${d.referredBy || d.officerName || 'غير محدد'}</td>
            </tr>`;
        });
        document.getElementById('lbl-stat-negative').innerText = negCount;
        document.getElementById('lbl-stat-positive').innerText = posCount;
        if(tbody) tbody.innerHTML = html || '<tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align:center; color:#999;">💡 السجل السلوكي المركزي فارغ، لم يتم رصد أي حالات بعد.</td></tr>';
    });

    // 3. مراقبة التعاميم النشطة بالمدرسة
    const qCirc = query(collection(db, 'circulars'), where('schoolId', '==', schoolId));
    onSnapshot(qCirc, (snapshot) => {
        const tbody = document.getElementById('social-circulars-tbody');
        if(!tbody) return;
        let html = '';
        snapshot.forEach(doc => {
            const d = doc.data();
            html += `<tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
                <td>🕒 ${d.dateStr || '-'} - ${d.timeStr || '-'}</td> <td><b>📢 ${d.title || '-'}</b></td>
                <td><span style="background:var(--gold); color:#fff; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px;">${d.target || '-'}</span></td>
                <td style="color:var(--mid);">${d.content || '-'}</td> <td>أ. ${d.senderName || '-'}</td>
            </tr>`;
        });
        tbody.innerHTML = html || '<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center; color:#999;">💡 لا توجد تعاميم أو مراسلات صادرة لغاية الآن.</td></tr>';
    });
}

// تشغيل جرد الأرشيف يدوياً عند ضغط الزر
window.loadHistoricalArchiveLive = function() {
    startSocialCentralListeners(); 
};

// تدمير قنبلة الفواتير: تحميل الفصول ديناميكياً لصفحة الأخصائي عبر الدالة الموحدة الموفرة للتكاليف
async function loadSocialClassDropdowns() {
    try {
        const schoolId = getActiveSchoolId();
        if(!schoolId) return;

        // استدعاء الموديول المركزي لتجنب قراءة كامل مستندات الطلاب
        const classes = await getSchoolClasses(db, schoolId);

        const opts = '<option value="">-- اختر الفصل --</option>' + classes.map(c=>`<option value="${c}">${c}</option>`).join('');
        ['pass-class','beh-class','txt-profile-search-class'].forEach(id => {
            const el = document.getElementById(id);
            if(el) el.innerHTML = opts;
        });
    } catch(e) {
        ['pass-class','beh-class','txt-profile-search-class'].forEach(id => {
            const el = document.getElementById(id);
            if(el) el.innerHTML = '<option value="">⚠️ خطأ بتحميل الفصول</option>';
        });
    }
}

// Toast (بدل alert)
function showToast(msg, type='success') {
    document.querySelectorAll('.sw-toast').forEach(t=>t.remove());
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'sw-toast';
    const colors = {success:'#059669',error:'#dc2626',info:'#1a78c2',warning:'#d97706'};
    t.style.cssText = `position:fixed;bottom:80px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:11px 22px;
        border-radius:12px;font-family:'Cairo',sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;z-index:99999;
        color:#fff;background:${colors[type]||colors.success};box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
        white-space:nowrap;max-width:90vw;text-align:center;`;
    t.textContent = msg;
    document.body.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{t.style.opacity='0';t.style.transition='opacity .4s';setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),400);},2500);
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const user = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('hs_user'));
    if (!user || user.role !== 'social_worker') {
        window.location.replace('index.html');
        return;
    }
    currentWorkerId = user.userId;
    currentWorkerName = user.name || "الأخصائي الاجتماعي";
    
    document.getElementById('lbl-worker-title').innerHTML = `<i class="bi bi-person-workspace"></i> بوابة الأخصائي: أ. ${currentWorkerName}`;
    document.getElementById('lbl-social-school').textContent = user.schoolName || 'المنظومة الرقمية السحابية الموحدة';
    document.getElementById('social-profile-name').value = currentWorkerName;

    (async () => {
        try {
            const q = query(collection(db,'users'), where('schoolId','==',getActiveSchoolId()), where('userId','==',currentWorkerId));
            const snap = await getDocs(q);
            if(!snap.empty) {
                const d = snap.docs[0].data();
                document.getElementById('social-profile-email').value = d.email || '';
                document.getElementById('social-profile-phone').value = d.phone || '';
            }
        } catch(e) {}
    })();
    document.getElementById('txt-search-date').value = getUnifiedDateString();
    
    startSocialCentralListeners();
    
    // تحميل الفصول ديناميكياً من نظام الكاش والفهرسة المحسن
    loadSocialClassDropdowns();
    
    // التغذية التلقائية للمساقط عند أول تشغيل
    window.populateStudentsDropdownUnified('pass-class', 'pass-student-name');
    window.populateStudentsDropdownUnified('beh-class', 'beh-student-name');
    window.populateStudentsDropdownUnified('txt-profile-search-class', 'txt-profile-search-name');

    document.getElementById('splash-school').textContent = user.schoolName || 'المنظومة الرقمية';
    document.getElementById('splash').classList.add('hide');
});

if('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
    navigator.serviceWorker.register('./sw.js').catch(e => console.warn('SW:', e));
}

        // تحقق من التحديثات كل 5 دقائق

    }).catch(function() {});
}

// ===== ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¥أ¢â‚¬â„¢ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¦ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ© ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¹أ¢â‚¬آ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ«ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¢ط¢آ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ­ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ© ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ§ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¹أ¢â‚¬آ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ­ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¦ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬â€چط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¦ =====
function initDashboard() {
  onSnapshot(collection(db,'schools'), snap => {
    allSchools = [];
    snap.forEach(docSnap => allSchools.push({ id: docSnap.id, ...docSnap.data() }));
    updateStats();
    renderSchools();
    checkExpiryAlerts();
  });
}

// ===== ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¥ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ­ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آµط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ§ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¦ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ§ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ =====
function updateStats() {
  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
  const soon  = new Date(); soon.setDate(soon.getDate()+30);
  const soonStr = soon.toISOString().slice(0,10);

  let active=0, expiring=0, suspended=0, revenue=0;
  allSchools.forEach(s => {
    const isActive = s.status === 'active';
    const isExpired = s.subscriptionEnd && s.subscriptionEnd < today;
    const isExpiring = s.subscriptionEnd && s.subscriptionEnd >= today && s.subscriptionEnd <= soonStr;
    if(isActive && !isExpired) { active++; revenue += PLANS[s.plan||'pro']||250; }
    if(isExpiring) expiring++;
    if(!isActive || isExpired) suspended++;
  });

  document.getElementById('s-total').textContent    = allSchools.length;
  document.getElementById('s-active').textContent   = active;
  document.getElementById('s-expiring').textContent = expiring;
  document.getElementById('s-suspended').textContent= suspended;
  document.getElementById('s-revenue').textContent  = revenue;
}

ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¦ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¯ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ±ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ³ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ© window.setFilter = function(f, btn) {
  currentFilter = f;
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  renderSchools();
};

// ===== ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ±ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¶ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ§ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¹أ¢â‚¬آ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¦ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¯ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ§ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ±ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ³ =====
window.renderSchools = function() {
  const today   = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
  const soon    = new Date(); soon.setDate(soon.getDate()+30);
  const soonStr = soon.toISOString().slice(0,10);
  const search  = document.getElementById('school-search')?.value.toLowerCase() || '';

  let filtered = allSchools.filter(s => {
    const matchSearch = !search || (s.name||'').toLowerCase().includes(search) || s.id.toLowerCase().includes(search);
    if(!matchSearch) return false;

    const isExpired  = s.subscriptionEnd && s.subscriptionEnd < today;
    const isExpiring = s.subscriptionEnd && s.subscriptionEnd >= today && s.subscriptionEnd <= soonStr;
    const isActive   = s.status==='active' && !isExpired;

    if(currentFilter==='active')   return isActive;
    if(currentFilter==='expiring') return isExpiring;
    if(currentFilter==='suspended')return s.status==='suspended';
    if(currentFilter==='expired')  return isExpired;
    return true;
  });

  if(filtered.length === 0) {
    document.getElementById('schools-tbody').innerHTML =
      '<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center;padding:32px;color:var(--mid)">ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¹أ¢â‚¬آ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ§ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ«ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¢ط¢آ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¯ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ§ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¦ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¬</td></tr>';
    return;
  }

  document.getElementById('schools-tbody').innerHTML = filtered.map(s => {
    const isExpired  = s.subscriptionEnd && s.subscriptionEnd < today;
    const isExpiring = s.subscriptionEnd && s.subscriptionEnd >= today && s.subscriptionEnd <= soonStr;
    const isActive   = s.status==='active' && !isExpired;
    const daysLeft   = s.subscriptionEnd
      ? Math.ceil((new Date(s.subscriptionEnd) - new Date()) / 864e5) : null;

    let statusBadge, endColor;
    if(isExpired) {
      statusBadge = '<span class="badge expired">ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ£ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ«ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¢آ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ° ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¦ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¥أ¢â‚¬â„¢ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹</span>';
      endColor = 'color:var(--red)';
    } else if(s.status==='suspended') {
      statusBadge = '<span class="badge suspended">ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ£ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¥â€™ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ«ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¢آ  ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¦ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ«ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¢ط¢آ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¹ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹آ©ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ«ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¢ط¢آ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾</span>';
      endColor = 'color:var(--mid)';
    } else if(isExpiring) {
      statusBadge = `<span class="badge" style="background:#fef3c7;color:var(--warn)">ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ£ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¹ط¢آ©ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ£ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¯ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ«ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¢آ  ${daysLeft}ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹</span>`;
      endColor = 'color:var(--warn)';
    } else {
      statusBadge = '<span class="badge active">ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ£ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¥â€™ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ«ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¢آ  ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ§ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¹أ¢â‚¬آ </span>';
      endColor = 'color:var(--green)';
    }

    const planKey = s.plan||'pro';
    const planBadge = `<span class="plan-badge plan-${planKey}">${PLAN_ICONS[planKey]} ${PLAN_NAMES[planKey]||planKey}</span>`;

    return `<tr>
      <td>
        <b style="color:var(--navy)">${s.name||s.id}</b><br>
        <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--mid)">${s.id}</span>
        ${s.notes ? `<br><span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--mid);font-style:italic">${s.notes}</span>` : ''}
      </td>
      <td>${planBadge}</td>
      <td>${statusBadge}</td>
      <td style="${endColor};font-weight:700;font-size:12px">
        ${s.subscriptionEnd||'ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ£ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¹أ¢â‚¬ع©ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¥أ¢â‚¬â„¢'}
        ${daysLeft!==null ? `<br><span style="font-size:10px">(${daysLeft>0?daysLeft+'ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¦ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¨ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¹ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹آ©ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹':'ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¦ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¥أ¢â‚¬â„¢ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹'})</span>` : ''}

          <span class="date">${v.subEnd||'ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ£ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¹أ¢â‚¬ع©ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¥أ¢â‚¬â„¢'}</span>

        </div>`;
      }).join('');
      histWrap.style.display='block';
    } else {
      histWrap.style.display='none';
    }
  } catch(e) {}

  openModal('renew-modal');
};

window.submitRenewal = async function() {
  if(!currentRenewId) return;
  const plan    = document.getElementById('renew-plan').value;
  const endDate = document.getElementById('renew-end-date').value;
  const notes   = document.getElementById('renew-notes').value.trim();
  const errEl   = document.getElementById('renew-error');

  if(!endDate) { errEl.textContent='ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ£ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¹ط¢آ©ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ£ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¯ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ«ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¢آ  ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ§ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ®ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ± ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ§ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ±ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ® ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ§ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¹أ¢â‚¬آ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ§ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¥أ¢â‚¬â„¢ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ§ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¥ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬أ¢â€‍آ¢'; errEl.style.display='block'; return; }
  errEl.style.display='none';

  try {
    const school = allSchools.find(s=>s.id===currentRenewId);
    await updateDoc(doc(db,'schools',currentRenewId), {
      plan, status:'active', subscriptionEnd: endDate,
      lastRenewed: serverTimestamp()
    });

    await addDoc(collection(db,'subscription_logs'), {
      schoolId: currentRenewId, schoolName: school?.name||currentRenewId,

      type:'renewal', notes, createdAt: serverTimestamp()
    });

    closeModal('renew-modal');
    alert(`ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ£ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¥ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¥أ¢â‚¬إ“ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¦ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¦ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¯ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¯ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ§ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ´ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ±ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ§ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¦ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬â€چط¢آ¢ "${school?.name||currentRenewId}" ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ­ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ° ${endDate}`);

// ===== ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ±ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¹ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹آ©ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ© ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ§ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¹أ¢â‚¬آ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¨ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ§ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¹ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹آ©ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ© =====
window.openUpgradeModal = function(schoolId, schoolName, currentPlan) {
  currentUpgradeId = schoolId;
  document.getElementById('upgrade-school-name').textContent = schoolName;
  document.getElementById('upgrade-plan').value = currentPlan;
  openModal('upgrade-modal');
};

window.submitUpgrade = async function() {
  if(!currentUpgradeId) return;
  const plan = document.getElementById('upgrade-plan').value;
  try {
    const school = allSchools.find(s=>s.id===currentUpgradeId);
    await updateDoc(doc(db,'schools',currentUpgradeId), { plan });
    await addDoc(collection(db,'subscription_logs'), {
      schoolId: currentUpgradeId, schoolName: school?.name||currentUpgradeId,
      plan, amount: PLANS[plan]||250, type:'upgrade',
      notes:`ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ±ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¹ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹آ©ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ© ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¥ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¹أ¢â‚¬آ ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ° ${PLAN_NAMES[plan]}`, createdAt: serverTimestamp()

// ===== ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¹أ¢â‚¬آ /ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¥ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¹ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹آ©ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ§ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ =====
window.toggleSchool = async function(schoolId, newStatus) {
  const school = allSchools.find(s=>s.id===schoolId);
  const msg = newStatus==='suspended' ? `ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¥ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ·ط¢آ¹ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹آ©ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ§ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ "${school?.name||schoolId}"ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط·â€؛` : `ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¾ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ¸ط·آ·ط¢آ£ط·آ¢ط¢آ¢ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط¹â€کط·آ¢ط¢آ¬ط·آ£ط¢آ¢ط£آ¢أ¢â‚¬ع‘ط¢آ¬ط·آ¹أ¢â‚¬آ  "${school?.name||schoolId}"ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ¢ط·آ¢ط¢آ·ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط·آ¢ط¢آ¹ط·آ·ط¢آ·ط£آ¢أ¢â€ڑآ¬ط·â€؛`;
  if(!confirm(msg)) return;
  await updateDoc(doc(db,'schools',schoolId), { status: newStatus });
};

const CACHE_NAME = 'manzoma-v9';
const STATIC_ASSETS = [
    './',
    './index.html',
    './admin.html',
    './teacher.html',
    './parent.html',
    './department_head.html',
    './style.css',
    './manifest.json',
    './logo.png',
    './js/firebase-config.js',
    './js/security.js',
    './js/utils.js',
    './js/cleanup.js',
    './js/pagination.js'
];

// تثبيت: خزّن الملفات الأساسية
self.addEventListener('install', function(event) {
    event.waitUntil(
        caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then(function(cache) {
            return cache.addAll(STATIC_ASSETS.map(function(url) {
                return new Request(url, { cache: 'reload' });
            }));
        }).then(function() {
            return self.skipWaiting();
        }).catch(function(e) {
            console.warn('SW install error:', e);
        })
    );
});

// تفعيل: احذف الكاش القديم
self.addEventListener('activate', function(event) {
    event.waitUntil(
        caches.keys().then(function(keys) {
            return Promise.all(
                keys.filter(function(key) { return key !== CACHE_NAME; })
                    .map(function(key) { return caches.delete(key); })
            );
        }).then(function() {
            return self.clients.claim();
        })
    );
});

// الطلبات: Network First للـ HTML، Cache First للملفات الثابتة
self.addEventListener('fetch', function(event) {
    var url = event.request.url;

    // تجاهل Firebase وGoogle
    if (url.includes('firestore.googleapis.com') ||
        url.includes('firebase.googleapis.com') ||
        url.includes('identitytoolkit.googleapis.com') ||
        url.includes('googleapis.com') ||
        url.includes('cloudfunctions.net') ||
        url.includes('gstatic.com') ||
        url.includes('fonts.googleapis.com')) {
        return;
    }

    // HTML: Network First مع fallback
    if (event.request.mode === 'navigate' ||
        (event.request.method === 'GET' &&
         event.request.headers.get('accept') &&
         event.request.headers.get('accept').includes('text/html'))) {
        event.respondWith(
            fetch(event.request).then(function(response) {
                if (response && response.status === 200) {
                    var clone = response.clone();
                    caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then(function(cache) {
                        cache.put(event.request, clone);
                    });
                }
                return response;
            }).catch(function() {
                return caches.match(event.request).then(function(cached) {
                    return cached || caches.match('./index.html');
                });
            })
        );
        return;
    }

    // ملفات ثابتة: Cache First
    if (event.request.method === 'GET') {
        event.respondWith(
            caches.match(event.request).then(function(cached) {
                if (cached) return cached;
                return fetch(event.request).then(function(response) {
                    if (response && response.status === 200 && response.type !== 'opaque') {
                        var clone = response.clone();
                        caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then(function(cache) {
                            cache.put(event.request, clone);
                        });
                    }
                    return response;
                }).catch(function() {
                    return caches.match('./index.html');
                });
            })
        );
    }
});

// Offline page
self.addEventListener('message', function(event) {
    if (event.data && event.data.type === 'SKIP_WAITING') {
        self.skipWaiting();
    }
    if (event.data && event.data.type === 'CACHE_URLS') {
        caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then(function(cache) {
            cache.addAll(event.data.urls || []);
        });
    }
});
